SELECT 
  CAST(SUM(trans_count) AS TEXT) as sum_counts,
  CAST(AVG(share) AS TEXT) as avg_share,
  CAST(AVG(excess) AS TEXT) as avg_excess
FROM (
  SELECT 
    t.tradekind,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ab.translink) as trans_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ab.translink) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT ab.translink)) OVER () as share,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ab.translink) - (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ab2.translink) as cnt FROM advancedbehavior ab2 JOIN transactionrecord tr2 ON ab2.translink = tr2.transreg JOIN trader t2 ON tr2.trdref = t2.tradereg GROUP BY t2.tradekind)) as excess
  FROM advancedbehavior ab 
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg 
  JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg 
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
)
WHERE trans_count > (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ab2.translink) as cnt FROM advancedbehavior ab2 JOIN transactionrecord tr2 ON ab2.translink = tr2.transreg JOIN trader t2 ON tr2.trdref = t2.tradereg GROUP BY t2.tradekind))
